capabilities: : Convert spreadsheet cells to Markdown tables
: Convert CSV or tab-separated text to tables
: Copy Markdown tables back to spreadsheet formats
: Edit table structure (insert/delete rows/columns, sort, align)
intentEvidence: Obsidian already turns a pasted spreadsheet selection into a table, but the table it makes has an empty header row, with your real header pushed down into the body.
problem: Obsidian's default paste function often results in tables with empty header rows, and it fails to convert raw tab-separated or CSV text into tables.
summary: A tool that converts pasted spreadsheet cells from various applications into Markdown tables, handles CSV/tab-separated text, and exports tables back to spreadsheet formats.
